answer: Commit the receipt hash before the work, reveal it after, and release payment only when three jurors from unrelated clusters confirm the same reveal. A forged claim fails because the hash it needs was never committed; duplicates die by replay rather than by name, so one thread of copied output cannot be sold twice and a marble of reused proof cannot be re-cut in the same forge. Whether three confirmations hold against a patient forger is the open question.
